cookbook.title: Hygiene: dedupe retries + drop service-principal noise
cookbook.blurb: Always do this first. RecordId can appear more than once across overlapping audit pages. UserType 4/5/6 are System / Application / ServicePrincipal — almost always noise for end-user analytics.

snippets.KQL:
PAX
| where UserType !in ('4','5','6','System','Application','ServicePrincipal')
| summarize arg_max(CreationTime, *) by RecordId
snippets.T-SQL:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RecordId ORDER BY CreationTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM dbo.PAX
  WHERE UserType NOT IN ('4','5','6','System','Application','ServicePrincipal')
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;
snippets.SPL:
index=pax sourcetype=pax_purview
| search NOT UserType IN (4,5,6,"System","Application","ServicePrincipal")
| dedup RecordId sortby -CreationTime
snippets.Pandas:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('Purview_Audit_UsageActivity_*.csv')
df = df[~df['UserType'].astype(str).isin(['4','5','6','System','Application','ServicePrincipal'])]
df = df.sort_values('CreationTime').drop_duplicates('RecordId', keep='last')

cookbook.title: Top users by token spend, last 7 days
cookbook.blurb: Cost-attribution starter. Group by UserId, sum TokensTotal, rank.

snippets.KQL:
PAX
| where RecordType == '261'
| where CreationTime >= ago(7d)
| summarize Turns = count(),
            InputTokens = sum(toint(TokensInput)),
            OutputTokens = sum(toint(TokensOutput)),
            TotalTokens = sum(toint(TokensTotal))
          by UserId
| top 25 by TotalTokens desc
snippets.T-SQL:
SELECT TOP 25
  UserId,
  COUNT(*)                        AS Turns,
  SUM(TRY_CAST(TokensInput  AS INT)) AS InputTokens,
  SUM(TRY_CAST(TokensOutput AS INT)) AS OutputTokens,
  SUM(TRY_CAST(TokensTotal  AS INT)) AS TotalTokens
FROM dbo.PAX
WHERE RecordType = '261'
  AND CreationTime >= DATEADD(day, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME())
GROUP BY UserId
ORDER BY TotalTokens DESC;
snippets.SPL:
index=pax sourcetype=pax_purview RecordType=261 earliest=-7d@d
| stats count AS Turns,
        sum(TokensInput)  AS InputTokens,
        sum(TokensOutput) AS OutputTokens,
        sum(TokensTotal)  AS TotalTokens
      by UserId
| sort -TotalTokens
| head 25
snippets.Pandas:
cop = df[df['RecordType'].astype(str) == '261'].copy()
cop['CreationTime'] = pd.to_datetime(cop['CreationTime'], utc=True)
cop = cop[cop['CreationTime'] >= pd.Timestamp.utcnow() - pd.Timedelta(days=7)]
for c in ('TokensInput','TokensOutput','TokensTotal'):
    cop[c] = pd.to_numeric(cop[c], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
print(cop.groupby('UserId')
         .agg(Turns=('RecordId','count'),
              InputTokens=('TokensInput','sum'),
              OutputTokens=('TokensOutput','sum'),
              TotalTokens=('TokensTotal','sum'))
         .nlargest(25,'TotalTokens'))

cookbook.title: Failed Copilot turns in the last 24h with retry context
cookbook.blurb: Find which surfaces and models are producing failures, and whether retries eventually succeeded.

snippets.KQL:
PAX
| where RecordType == '261'
| where CreationTime >= ago(24h)
| where OutcomeStatus == 'Failure'
| summarize Failures = count(),
            AvgRetries = avg(toint(RetryCount)),
            DistinctUsers = dcount(UserId)
          by AppHost, ModelName, ModelVendor
| order by Failures desc
snippets.T-SQL:
SELECT AppHost, ModelName, ModelVendor,
       COUNT(*)                              AS Failures,
       AVG(TRY_CAST(RetryCount AS FLOAT))    AS AvgRetries,
       COUNT(DISTINCT UserId)                AS DistinctUsers
FROM dbo.PAX
WHERE RecordType = '261'
  AND OutcomeStatus = 'Failure'
  AND CreationTime >= DATEADD(hour, -24, SYSUTCDATETIME())
GROUP BY AppHost, ModelName, ModelVendor
ORDER BY Failures DESC;
snippets.SPL:
index=pax sourcetype=pax_purview RecordType=261 OutcomeStatus=Failure earliest=-24h
| stats count AS Failures,
        avg(RetryCount) AS AvgRetries,
        dc(UserId)      AS DistinctUsers
      by AppHost, ModelName, ModelVendor
| sort -Failures
snippets.Pandas:
f = df[(df['RecordType'].astype(str)=='261') & (df['OutcomeStatus']=='Failure')].copy()
f['CreationTime'] = pd.to_datetime(f['CreationTime'], utc=True)
f = f[f['CreationTime'] >= pd.Timestamp.utcnow() - pd.Timedelta(hours=24)]
f['RetryCount'] = pd.to_numeric(f['RetryCount'], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
print(f.groupby(['AppHost','ModelName','ModelVendor'])
        .agg(Failures=('RecordId','count'),
             AvgRetries=('RetryCount','mean'),
             DistinctUsers=('UserId','nunique'))
        .sort_values('Failures', ascending=False))

cookbook.title: Copilot turns that grounded on labelled content
cookbook.blurb: Conservative pattern — joins to whichever sensitivity field a given surface emits. After dedup, hand off to your MIP label registry to resolve GUIDs.

snippets.KQL:
PAX
| where RecordType == '261'
| where isnotempty(column_ifexists('AccessedResources[0].SensitivityLabel',''))
     or isnotempty(column_ifexists('SensitivityLabels[0].Id',''))
     or isnotempty(SiteSensitivityLabelId)
| project CreationTime, UserId, AppHost, ConversationId, TurnNumber,
          AccessedResource = column_ifexists('AccessedResources[0].Type',''),
          LabelOnResource  = column_ifexists('AccessedResources[0].SensitivityLabel',''),
          LabelOnTurn      = column_ifexists('SensitivityLabels[0].Id',''),
          LabelOnSite      = SiteSensitivityLabelId
snippets.T-SQL:
SELECT CreationTime, UserId, AppHost, ConversationId, TurnNumber,
       [AccessedResources[0].Type]              AS AccessedResource,
       [AccessedResources[0].SensitivityLabel]  AS LabelOnResource,
       [SensitivityLabels[0].Id]                AS LabelOnTurn,
       SiteSensitivityLabelId                   AS LabelOnSite
FROM dbo.PAX
WHERE RecordType = '261'
  AND (NULLIF([AccessedResources[0].SensitivityLabel],'') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF([SensitivityLabels[0].Id],'')               IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(SiteSensitivityLabelId,'')                  IS NOT NULL);
snippets.SPL:
index=pax sourcetype=pax_purview RecordType=261
  (AccessedResources{}.SensitivityLabel=* OR SensitivityLabels{}.Id=* OR SiteSensitivityLabelId=*)
| table _time UserId AppHost ConversationId TurnNumber
        AccessedResources{}.Type AccessedResources{}.SensitivityLabel
        SensitivityLabels{}.Id SiteSensitivityLabelId
snippets.Pandas:
cop = df[df['RecordType'].astype(str)=='261'].copy()
mask = (cop.get('AccessedResources[0].SensitivityLabel', pd.Series(dtype=str)).fillna('') != '')
     | (cop.get('SensitivityLabels[0].Id',               pd.Series(dtype=str)).fillna('') != '')
     | (cop.get('SiteSensitivityLabelId',                 pd.Series(dtype=str)).fillna('') != '')
print(cop.loc[mask, ['CreationTime','UserId','AppHost','ConversationId','TurnNumber',
                     'AccessedResources[0].Type',
                     'AccessedResources[0].SensitivityLabel',
                     'SensitivityLabels[0].Id',
                     'SiteSensitivityLabelId']])

gotchas.title: Exchange ResultStatus is True/False, not Succeeded/Failed
gotchas.body: Exchange records emit ResultStatus values 'True'/'False' while every other workload uses 'Succeeded'/'Failed'. Normalize before filtering or your Exchange rows will silently disappear.

gotchas.title: RecordId is the dedupe key — Id is not
gotchas.body: The audit pipeline can serve the same RecordId twice across overlapping page boundaries. AuditData.Id usually equals RecordId but isn't guaranteed across schema versions. Dedupe on RecordId, keep the latest CreationTime.

gotchas.title: CED.* columns are empty for every Path A (non-Copilot) row
gotchas.body: Non-Copilot records flow through Path A and produce exactly one flat row with all CopilotEventData-derived columns blank. Don't inner-join on AppHost / ConversationId / TokensTotal when you mean to scope to file activity — you'll drop every row.

gotchas.title: One Copilot turn can explode to 50+ flat rows
gotchas.body: Path B explodes Messages × Contexts × AccessedResources × AISystemPlugin × ModelTransparencyDetails × SensitivityLabels. A turn that grounded on 12 files and used 4 plugins is 12 × 4 = 48 rows. Always aggregate (distinct ConversationId/TurnNumber) before joining to user-level dimensions or your token totals will multiply.

gotchas.title: UserType is numeric in raw, text after enrichment
gotchas.body: Raw audit emits 0–8. Some Power BI flows label them (Regular/Admin/System/etc.). Filter on BOTH forms ('4','System') so the same query works regardless of whether the dataset was enriched.

gotchas.title: First-party ApplicationId GUIDs look like noise but are signal
gotchas.body: 00000003-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000 is SharePoint, 1fec8e78-bce4-4aaf-ab1b-5451cc387264 is Teams, fb78d390-0c51-40cd-8e17-fdbfab77341b is Copilot. Maintain a lookup table — most 'mystery actor' rows in audit are well-known first-party clients.

gotchas.title: DurationMs is sometimes 0, -1, or missing
gotchas.body: Different Copilot surfaces report timing under DurationMs / ElapsedMs / ProcessingTimeMs / LatencyMs. PAX falls through them in that order. If you average DurationMs cluster-wide, exclude rows where DurationMs <= 0 or you'll wreck your p50.

gotchas.title: Every timestamp is UTC — convert at the display layer only
gotchas.body: CreationDate, CreationTime, and every CED.* timestamp are UTC. Don't convert to local time during ingestion; do it only when you render. Multi-region tenants need UTC-keyed joins or your day boundaries won't match.

samples.title: Copilot turn (Path B explosion)
samples.explode_note: Flattens to max(len(Messages)=2, len(AccessedResources)=2, len(ModelTransparencyDetails)=1) = 2 rows. Row i=0 picks Messages[0], AccessedResources[0], ModelTransparencyDetails[0]; row i=1 picks Messages[1], AccessedResources[1], and ModelTransparencyDetails[0] (last value re-used / empty per surface convention). Token totals appear identically on both rows — aggregate by ConversationId+TurnNumber before summing.

samples.title: SharePoint file access (Path A)
samples.explode_note: Produces exactly 1 flat row. CED.*, Messages[*], AccessedResources[*], ModelTransparencyDetails[*], SensitivityLabels[*], Tokens* all empty. DeviceProperties pivot pulls only OS=Windows and BrowserType=Edge; IsCompliant is dropped.

glossary.definition: PAX's non-Copilot processing branch. Every audit record produces exactly one flat output row.
PAX's Copilot processing branch. One record can produce N rows via the explosion of its CopilotEventData arrays.
Post-processor invoked via the -Rollup or -RollupPlusRaw switch. Reads the deterministic raw output and produces the flat, explosion-applied dataset consumed by AI-in-One.
Short for AuditData.CopilotEventData — the nested object inside Copilot records that carries everything specific to a turn.
Per-record array fan-out that turns one Copilot record into N rows. N = max length across Messages / Contexts / AccessedResources / AISystemPlugin / ModelTransparencyDetails / SensitivityLabels.
Columns added under -AppendFile that record which batch / source file / ingestion timestamp produced each row. Used to roll back a bad ingest.
Stable table or file name (e.g., Purview_Audit_UsageActivity) that PAX overwrites/upserts on each run, so downstream queries don't need date-suffixed targets.
Output target class inferred from the -OutputPath URL: Local (drive path), SP (*.sharepoint.com), Fabric (*.onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<…>.Lakehouse/…).
Lift of a Name/Value pair array onto fixed columns. PAX pivots only DeviceProperties[Name='OS' or 'BrowserType']; everything else in DeviceProperties is dropped.
The agreed flat-column schema between PAX and downstream consumers. 153 base columns plus up to 5 provenance columns under -Append* modes.
Delta-table write option PAX uses when emitting to Fabric: existing columns are preserved, new columns are added, no destructive overwrite.
Risk signal: the principal executing PAX differs from the resource owner. Most often appears when running PAX under Managed Identity against a workspace not owned by that identity.

added: Single -OutputPath* switches with tier inferred from URL form (drive vs *.sharepoint.com vs *.onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<…>.Lakehouse/…)
Symmetric -Append* switches with union-merge + provenance columns

-ExplodeArrays / -ExplodeDeep / -ExplosionThreads (replaced by always-on Path B explosion under -Rollup)
-RAWInputCSV (raw passthrough mode; use the unrolled output directly)
